crossRefs.note: Unless Yahweh builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless Yahweh watches over the city, the watchman…
It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
Blessed be Yahweh, my rock, who teaches my hands to war, and my fingers to battle:
Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
For she didn’t know that I gave her the grain, the new wine, and the oil, and multiplied to her silver and gold, which…
but because Yahweh loves you, and because he desires to keep the oath which he swore to your fathers, Yahweh has…
It shall happen, because you listen to these ordinances and keep and do them, that Yahweh your God will keep with you…

translations.web: But you shall remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers, as it is today.
translations.bsb: But remember that it is the LORD your God who gives you the power to gain wealth, in order to confirm His covenant that He swore to your fathers even to this day.
translations.kjv: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.
translations.asv: But thou shalt remember Jehovah thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth; that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as at this day.
